scope: The runs behind the fixes for the second Copilot review of pull request 101 (issue 97): the trust gate extended to every answer of discovery, on formal-ledger-specifications master with a fresh cache, state and configuration (nix's own configuration copied in, so nothing of the user's was read or written); the gc root a dev shell's profile gets, with Nix itself; the silence before a first evaluation, under the stub nix; and Agda's own search for a library across a nested repository.  Every store path the formal-ledger-specifications runs name was already in the store, so a first call links a root and evaluates, and builds nothing.  Each timing is a single observation, not a benchmark.

tests.command: node --test scripts/agda-for-project/test.mjs, and with AGDA_FOR_PROJECT=<nix build .#agda-for-project>/bin/agda-for-project
tests.againstTheLauncherBefore: 61fcc2b's launcher under the same suite: 17 pass, 7 fail (the line before a first evaluation; the profile's place; a dev shell entered for another key since; the dev shell's refusal line; an untrusted flake's environment; reason; an attribute without nix)
tests.mutationProbes: ten breaks of 8334b9e's launcher, each caught by at least one case: the line spoken outside git; trust offered to a trusted flake; trust offered where it decides nothing; trust:DIR not checked; discovery run without trust; the last entered key not compared; --choose trust: keeping the project's choice; no newline before the appended line; reason not reported; an attribute passed over without nix

trust.what: ~/git/IO/fls/master, src/Ledger.lagda.md, with the launcher at 8334b9e and no trust file

stderr: agda-for-project: evaluating ~/git/IO/fls/master to find its Agda (key ba8a8dc4ab8e20702a7c9dae24c28b6e); once per key

agda-for-project: ~/git/IO/fls/master is not trusted, and running its Agda environment fls-agdaWithPackages runs the flake's code as you: allow it with --choose trust:~/git/IO/fls/master (every flake at or below it) or --choose package:fls-agdaWithPackages (this project), or list a directory at or above it in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/agda-for-project/trusted

granted.stderr: agda-for-project: trusted ~/git and every flake below it ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/agda-for-project/trusted)

trusted.warmStderr: Agda's own --version text only, the same as the environment's agda run directly; nothing of the launcher's

devShellRoot.what: where Nix registers the root of nix develop --profile P, for this repository's own dev shell (/nix/store/x5gs3hm8ayhick1y39rpf3n720drghn4-nix-shell-env)

madeInATemporaryDirectory.note: The launcher at 61fcc2b made the profile so and moved the directory into place; the next nix store gc could then collect the env.  No gc was run.

devShellRoot.threeEntriesAtOnePath: one generation, k.profile -> k.profile-1-link, and that link listed as the env's root

throughTheLauncher.what: a scratch flake whose default dev shell's hook writes .agda/bin/agda (a wrapper of the Agda 2.8.0 above), trusted with --choose trust:, then agda-for-project --explain --json

silence.what: agda-for-project --version on a trusted checkout with one environment, a cold cache, and a stub nix whose two flake evaluations take 2 s each; seconds from the start to each stderr line

lines: evaluating ... to find its Agda (key ...); once per key

nestedLibrary.what: Agda 2.8.0 (/nix/store/0vx59n9g1597p7gzmflmmya161hr695h-agdaWithPackages-2.8.0/bin/agda) checking X.agda in outer/nested/, where outer/nested/.git is a repository and outer/outer.agda-lib says depend: no-such-library
nestedLibrary.conclusion: Agda's search for a file's library does not stop at a nested repository's .git, so neither does the launcher's.

choicesListed.what: the cost of sharing choices only among the working trees `git worktree list` gives, on ~/git/IO/fls/master (46 listed), warm --version, alternating the launcher before (8334b9e) and after (d86ef94), seven runs each
choicesListed.plantedGitFile: under the stub nix, with no trust file: a directory with its own flake and a `.git` file reading `gitdir: <my checkout>/.git` took my checkout's devshell:default choice and entered its own dev shell (8334b9e); with d86ef94 it has no choice and is refused as untrusted
choicesListed.tests: d86ef94 adds a 25th case (two planted .git files), which fails against 8334b9e and under the mutation that drops the check

repositoryTrust.what: trust of a repository (c3c36e0), on ~/git/IO/fls/master with a fresh configuration and state (nix's own configuration copied in), and on one of its 46 worktrees, ~/git/IO/fls/worktrees/1276-dijkstra-gov-pov, never opened through the launcher before

firstCandidate.label: trust the repository of ~/git/IO/fls/master and every worktree git lists for it, now and later, so that discovery runs what it finds there as you (package:fls-agdaWithPackages here)

granted.stderr: agda-for-project: trusted the repository ~/git/IO/fls/master/.git and every worktree git lists for it ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/agda-for-project/trusted)

repositoryTrust.tests: c3c36e0 adds a 26th case; it and the two cases whose refusal line and first candidate changed fail against d86ef94, and five mutations of repository trust are caught

thirdReview.what: the fixes for Copilot's third review of pull request 101 (ced0af4), against the launcher before them (4c0dadf), with real Nix

lockFlags.flake: a scratch git flake whose tracked flake.lock locks one input, extra, and whose flake.nix (edited, not committed) names a second, extra2
lockFlags.noWriteLockFile: nix eval --no-write-lock-file evaluated: "Added input 'extra2'" at its newest revision, value "extra-1 extra2-1", nothing written
lockFlags.noUpdateLockFile: nix eval --no-update-lock-file failed: "requires lock file changes but they're not allowed due to '--no-update-lock-file'"
lockFlags.both: with both flags it evaluated, as under --no-write-lock-file alone
lockFlags.lockNeedingNoChange: --no-update-lock-file on the same flake with flake.nix as committed evaluated ("extra-1")
lockFlags.launcherBefore: 4c0dadf went on past the evaluation: "exports no Agda environment and no default dev shell"
lockFlags.launcherAfter: ced0af4 refused: "the flake.lock in <flake> does not lock every input flake.nix names; run 'nix flake lock' there", then "no Agda was run: Nix could not evaluate <flake>"

callerInsideTheShell.what: the scratch dev shell of devShellRoot (its hook writes .agda/bin/agda and prepends .agda/bin to PATH), trusted by directory, first entry (fresh cache) with PATH=<proj>/.agda/bin:$PATH and AGDA_DIR=<proj>/.agda, as a caller inside that shell by direnv has
callerInsideTheShell.pathOrder: nix develop puts the shell's PATH first and the caller's after: with a sentinel directory first in the caller's PATH, this repository's shell (no agda) found the sentinel's agda, at PATH entry 27, and the scratch shell found <proj>/.agda/bin/agda, at entry 1

launcherBefore.error: the dev shell <proj>#default adds no agda of its own (it finds <proj>/.agda/bin/agda, from the caller's PATH); see --candidates, then --choose

thirdReview.librariesFile: the environment's libraries file of fls master (/nix/store/6qscaqml...-libraries) ends with a newline (5 lines, 5 entries), as nixpkgs writes it; only a hand-written libraryFile lacked one
thirdReview.tests: 28 cases; against 4c0dadf's launcher 5 fail (the dev-shell refusal's line; the caller inside its shell and its AGDA_DIR; the entry that fails after its hook; the libraries file's last line; the outgrown lock); seven mutations, one per fix, each caught
